lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 14 distinct vertical white line segments traversing the torso. Spacing is wider (approx. 40-50 pixels) in the central midsection and narrows significantly towards the posterior haunch where lines become more fragmented.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: A distinct Y-shaped bifurcation is visible on the fifth line from the anterior, splitting approximately 1/3 of the way down from the dorsal ridge.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Dashed segments and isolated blobs are observed in the posterior-most 3 lines, which terminate prior to reaching the ventral boundary of the torso.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Cluster of approximately 8-10 high-contrast spots located on the lower haunch and upper hind limb area.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: A horizontal alignment of three spots is visible on the mid-thigh, creating a semi-connected geometric line segment.

other_distinctive_markers: Visible white chevron marking on the bridge of the nose between the eyes; prominent white hair fringe on the interior of the ears; white chin/throat patch visible despite foliage occlusion.
